4. Rights of personal data subject
The personal data subject has the right (unless otherwise provided by law):

• To demand clarification of personal data, blocking or destruction if the personal data is incomplete, outdated, unreliable, illegally obtained or is not necessary for the stated purpose of processing, as well as take measures provided by law to protect their rights;
• To request a list of their personal data, processed by the Company, and the source of their receipt;
• To receive information about the terms of processing of their personal data, including the terms about the period of their retention;

• To require notification of all persons who have previously been informed of incorrect or incomplete personal data about all exceptions, corrections or additions made to the personal data subject’s personal data;
• To appeal to the authorized body for the protection of the rights of personal data subjects or in court against illegal actions or omissions in the processing of his personal data;
• To protect their rights and legitimate interests, including compensation for damages and (or) compensation for moral damage in court.

If you have any questions about the nature of the application, use, modification or deletion of your personal data that you have provided, or if you wish to refuse of their further processing by the Company, please contact us by mail at the Company address or by e-mail: [LINK].

5. Implementation of personal data protection requirements

In order to maintain business reputation and ensure compliance with the requirements of federal legislation, the Company considers the most important tasks to ensure the legitimacy of personal data processing in the Company’s business processes and to ensure an appropriate level of personal data security processed in the Company.

The Company requires from other persons who have obtained access to personal data not to disclose it to third parties and not to distribute personal data without the consent of the personal data subject, unless otherwise provided by federal law.

In order to ensure the security of personal data during their processing, the Company takes the necessary and sufficient legal, organizational and technical measures to protect personal data from unauthorized or accidental access to them, destruction, modification, blocking, copying, provision, dissemination of personal data, as well as from other illegal actions in relation to them.

The Company seeks to ensure that all measures implemented by it for the organizational and technical protection of personal data are carried out on a lawful basis, including in accordance with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the processing of personal data.

In order to ensure adequate protection of personal data, the Company assesses the harm that may be caused to personal data subjects in the event of breach of the security of their personal data, and also determines current threats to the security of personal data when they are processed in personal data information systems.

In accordance with the identified current threats, the Company applies necessary and sufficient legal, organizational and technical measures to ensure security of personal data, including the use of information protection tools, detection of unauthorized access to personal data and taking measures, recovery of personal data, restriction of access to personal data, registration and accounting of actions with personal data, as well as control and evaluating the effectiveness of measures applied to ensure the security of personal data.

The Company’s management is aware of the importance and necessity of ensuring the security of personal data and encourages continuous improvement in the protection of personal data processed as part of the Company’s core business activities.
The Company has appointed persons responsible for organizing the processing and ensuring the security of personal data.

Each new employee of the Company who directly processes personal data acquaints with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on processing and security of personal data, this Policy and other local acts of the Company on processing and security of personal data and undertakes to comply with them.
